prompts.title: Website
prompts.summary: One original, polished website on a subject the model invents.
prompts.requirement: 5+ screens or sections, real copy, bespoke SVG art, one working interactive element

prompts.title: Useful app
prompts.summary: A complete everyday tool with data, persistence, undo and built-in self-checks.
prompts.requirement: 3 end-to-end workflows, undo, JSON import/export, 10 self-checks that pass

prompts.title: Algorithms lab
prompts.summary: Implement algorithms from scratch, visualise them step by step, then test them in the page.
prompts.requirement: 6+ algorithms with step animations, 30+ assertions, an editable function that re-runs the tests

prompts.title: Simulation tool
prompts.summary: A physical or control system with stated equations, live plots and an analytic self-check.
prompts.requirement: 5+ scenarios that each show a different behaviour, 3+ live plots, CSV export, solver check

prompts.title: three.js scenes
prompts.summary: Five distinct real-time 3D scenes, each a different visual idea, with custom shaders.
prompts.requirement: 5+ different scenes, custom GLSL in 2+ scenes, no external model or texture files

prompts.title: Arcade pack
prompts.summary: Five different, playable mini-games in one file, selected from a menu.
prompts.requirement: 5 distinct games, each with win/lose, sound, pause, high score and a self-test

prompts.title: Procedural images
prompts.summary: Original images generated purely in code, each by a different technique.
prompts.requirement: 5+ distinct generated images, seeded and reproducible, PNG download, palette per image

prompts.title: Short animated film
prompts.summary: A 45-90 second animated film built in code, with its own soundtrack and a timeline.
prompts.requirement: 5-7 scenes with transitions, synthesised soundtrack, scrubbing timeline, WebM recording

prompts.title: Tool-calling playground
prompts.summary: Design a set of tools, plan multi-step requests with them and trace every call.
prompts.requirement: 6+ tools with schemas, 6+ requests incl. chained calls, honest refusals, 12 checks that pass

prompts.title: Academic explainer
prompts.summary: A rigorous, interactive explainer on a topic the model chooses, with honest references.
prompts.requirement: Correct mathematics, 3+ sliders that change results, worked example, 5-question quiz
